name: CLINDAMYCIN / BENZOYL PEROXIDE 1/5 GR GEL 30 GR 1 PIECE
description: Clindamycin 1% / benzoyl peroxide 5% gel, in a 30-gram presentation, is a topical treatment for mild to moderate acne vulgaris. The combination of its active ingredients provides an antibiotic action that kills the Propionibacterium acnes bacteria and reduces comedones (blackheads and whiteheads). If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
